mind-poisoning.name: mind_poisoning
mind-poisoning.description: BETA CANDIDATE 0.1.27: identity-checked gossip and reflection can influence CHIM opinions. Optional default-off intimacy recognition stores an NPC's own report separately; it does not establish mutual agreement or willingness. Written-evidence API v1 can evaluate a confirmed message exposure submitted by a compatible server plugin; it does not verify authorship or provide an inbox. A compatible producer is required and not included. Deterministic fixtures, native integration and an official-manager development-candidate install pass; real-model interpretation, live installation and gameplay remain unverified. Standard release classification supports discovery without promoting maturity.
